points_and_relationships.observation: All five solid branches and all five dashed guides share the same horizontal and vertical axes, not five independent panels.
Left to right: guide 1, guide 2, solid vertical axis, guide 3, guide 4, guide 5.
Each of the five visibly descending branches crosses the common horizontal axis once, with a fraction-like label nearby.
The solid axes meet next to the 0-like label, between branches 2 and 3.
The five branch profiles and separations look broadly repeated. Exact equality of spacing, translation, shape, or period is UNKNOWN.
No alphabetically named point or clearly separate open/filled point marker is recognized; dark crossings and endpoints cannot certify marker semantics.

Fraction labels are optically readable as aliases, but exact numerator/denominator registration and codepoints are UNKNOWN.
